Name: New more emo Sebastian's Portraits and Sprites
Author: Jk202
Description:
[center]﻿[size=4]Hey,[/size]

So, I made it.
I officially created a mod.

[color=#ffff00]If you didn't know, I've been working on the new Sebastian's ﻿portraits and sprites designs for over a week or two now and I'm so happy that I finally made it official.
When I first made the mod, I wasn't sure if it would work. The first time I tried, it didn't work as expected, but on the second try, it finally worked.
I've tested it and can confirm that it works with mods (I have 27 mods currently installed in the game, some of them are furniture mods, and some are story mods, like Magg's immersive Sebastian, one of the best story mods I've played in a while ngl, so feel free to check it out).
[/color]
[color=#ff00ff][size=4]About the mod itself[/size][/color]

I added a bunch of new different portraits and sprites to the file, wich are:

[color=#00ff00]+ New Sebastian's Normal Portraits and Sprites[/color] [color=#e06666]+ Smoking Seb[/color]
[color=#ff7700](I added it but Idk if it will appear or not in the game, I have to check that out.)[/color]

[color=#00ff00]+ New Sebastian's Winter Portraits and Sprites[/color][color=#e06666] + Smoking Seb[/color]

&

[color=#00ff00]+ New Sebastian's Beach Portraits and Sprites [/color][color=#6fa8dc]+ No Smoking Seb added in the file[/color]
[size=4]
[/size][size=4][color=#ff00ff]How can the mod run in the game[/color]

[/size]1. To do this, first you must have[color=#00ffff] Smapi.io[/color] installed.
(Every Stardew mod runs on Smapi so check to se if It's installed.)

2. To really, really run the mod, you'll need a [color=#00ffff]Content Patcher.[/color]
(If you don't have this installed it will not work at all.)

[color=#ff00ff][size=4]What if the mod doesn't work[/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00]If the mod doesn't appear to be working feel free to tell me about it. I will make sure to try and fix it.
(I'm not a programmer and I followed a tutorial on youtube in how to make the mod itself but, I'll try <3)
[/color]
[color=#d5a6bd]Warning: I'm here to say that english it's not my first language so, If I said something wrong or misspelled something, you'll know why. Sorry.[/color]

[size=4]I really hope you like the mod and I hope that It runs in your game, as well as it worked for me.

Thank you for everything.

Bye<3.[/size][/center]
